fields.label: Episode
fields.description: Blank for run-level metrics (e.g. sequence entropy across all episodes).

fields.label: Phase
fields.description: Blank unless the metric is itself phase-scoped (e.g. post-shock error rate).

fields.label: Metric Version
fields.description: Versions the computation, not just the DocType, per spec section 17.3's explicit instruction to version e.g. the viable-path criterion.

fields.label: Metric Detail (JSON)
fields.description: Structured detail that doesn't fit a single float (e.g. a directly-follows graph, a communication network, or the viable-path set itself).
